node.statement: Node 1.2.1 proves the amended claim directly: compression idempotence identifies S_{A,B} with im(Co_{A,B}), compression adjointness sends Co_{A,B}(a) to Co_{B,A}(a^dagger), and its A=B=Q instance gives tilde Q^dagger=tilde Q. The former reversal conjunct has deliberately been removed: with the allowed inputs, the identity (a dot b)^dagger=b^dagger dot a^dagger is not derivable because no allowed or registered definition identifies a dot b with Co_{A,C}(ab). Consequently this amended node must not be used to justify the dot-reversal step in node 1.3.2; completing the root requires provisioning and registering def-compressed-corner (or another allowed axiom that explicitly defines dot), followed by a separately verified reversal node.
